note: A strict build over register 1 (#1736). Owners a and b of variable 5 share the source name 'Svar' and the operational definition 'Samma alternativ', so the rule gives both 'Svar — Samma alternativ'. That tie is a located error on each owner, and neither name is published.
fails_if: the build stops refusing two variables with one name in one variant (no duplicate_variable_name, or only for one of the two owners, so the strict build completes)

sources.description: Variable 5, named 'Svar', delivers A (CVID 21) and B (CVID 22) in edition 2020, both with the operational definition 'Samma alternativ'.
